translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content.text: Yawe, lalztqm mz nzkrka'-krbo bam.
X xlrm nzyrni-krnge mz nzokatr-krm.
Mzli ka tqprtz-ngrm nzkxpungr bange,
Bzkq mnc-rlrume bange.
A' ayzlu-anim natqnge
Mz nzkqle-krnge nim.
Nrkrdrtqnge nzpq-krde apule nyr.
X mzli trnaboiu ninge kc tqbzpex, tqapupex zsikapu kc tqmrbr ani.
Nabznge talvzo apupele nabr kxglr,
X trmupewxu.
Bztipenge nzyrningr mz nzetqkr drtqnge.
X nginitxpenge nrvr-nrbalq.
Apux nc kx nzrtclzngr mepz, x sc tqtaligxpe,
Mz nzmnc-krnge esz'-krnge.
Mnzx, a' trkrlzpewxu nzmwingr.
Apux ncblo kx trpnzngr kxnginide kx naoklatile nide.
Enqmi rngeng nzatrkati-zvzlr ninge mz nzycmne-krdr.
Nzpitrpzlr drtqnge mz nzrpibqti-krdr leplz.
Yawe, nzvzkr drtwrnge dekc tqkrlcngr nelznge tqngi dakxnzng nange,
X drle mzke' dekc tqngi lue pqnge.
Murde ngyati zlwz drtwrm ninge.
X apux brmrda kc tqrtctxpe-ngrn.
Nzmnc-krnge apule zmyo ngr milzpq
Kc tqmrbr mz nzyrkrpxkr ngrlx.
Kxmule-esz', a' nzngini-krm King tqyc tqyc.
Nrpr ngr ncblo amrlx sa nadcpx zvz mz drtwrdr nim.
Murde sa nayc mz drtwrm Jerusalem.
X mzli ka mzli r nzokatrpe-krmle.
Kxmule-esz' enqmi rm nzodatipelr mztea lc, x trkape,
A' sc tqsutibe drtwrgr x tqvztibe drtwrgr.
Yawe, lr mrkzbleng amrlx sa na-amrluelr drtqm.
X king amrlx mz nrlc sa na-amatqlr nim.
Murde mzli kc na-aelwapx-ngrn nzlulikr zmatq ngrm,
Mz nzwz-mou-krm Jerusalem,
Drtwr ngrde kx ayzlu-ngrme nzkrka'-krgr,
Nigr kcng trpnzngr scgr da.
Nayroku da kcng tqaleting Yawe,
Murde krkcng mztr trnzmcka naglqpx-kzlr nide.
Kxnamu nzyr-krgule sele: Yawe mnc Heven,
Mz ma nyzde kc tqtr tqmyalz, x sc tqobqom mz nrlc.
Xlrle nzyrni-krgu mz presin,
X aopxbzle drtqgu, nigu kcng tzpipx kx nanibqng.
X xlrpe-kzle nzngrkr leplz ngr mrkcng amrlx
Mzli kc tzyrlwr-lxblr-ngrdr Jerusalem,
Mz nzangio-krdr nide,
X nzglqpx-krdr drtqde.
Yawe, ngi-batrpe' nzyangrnga-krnge,
Mz nzamrbctr-krme nzlu-krnge, mzli ka tqngi-oblabe-ngrne.
A' rpibo bam kx, “Gct rnge, nzlu-krm tqyc tqyc.
Suti drtwrnge nakrlz-zpwxbo nzngi-lrtzlvz-krnge, x ninge kc tqbz-atex.
Mzli kc mz noude wz-ngrn nrlc,
Bongavz x dalrdeng amrlx.
Nrlc x bongavz sa nayrkrpxng kalr.
A' nim txpwz kx namnctx alo.
Mzli trnaboiu x sc tztrkapeng, tzapupelr lrpz kxblzlongr,
Kx nzrtctxngr x nztekqtr zvz mz kxmrna.
A' trtxpnzngr nzrtekqtrngr nim.
X trtxpnzngr nzbz-krm mz kzdq mzli.
Delc doa negrng sa namnc-zpwxng mz nrlc,
Murde sa na-aclve-angidrq nidr.”
